title: REQ · One validator, world.ts removed, imports updated
summary: world.ts is deleted and validator tests target loader.ts, covering unknown scene, object, character and flag references.
description: Context: validateWorld(world, scenes) in world.ts duplicates validateWorld(LoadedWorld) in loader.ts and is imported only by tests/validator.test.ts. Desired behavior: remove world.ts and test the loader.ts validator. Expected result: a single validator with tests for every reference kind. Why: avoids drift between two validators.
acceptance_criteria: Given src/content, when listed, then world.ts is absent
Given the invalid fixture world, when validateWorld runs, then errors contain unknown scene: nowhere, unknown character: ghost, unknown flag: zzz and unknown object: nope
Given the valid fixture world, when validateWorld runs, then it returns []
Given the real the-boys-room content, when validated, then it returns []
technical_constraints: Fixtures stay WorldDef plus SceneDef; tests compose them into a LoadedWorld
